_week: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22 (Week 47). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue rose 30% to $5,379 (from $4,138) on 138 units vs 88; net payout slipped 4% to $968 as ad spend rose 18% to $840.
The lift came Thu–Sun: $1,013–$1,184 a day vs $296–$375 Mon–Wed, as pre-Black Friday shopping started.
Essential Kit came back to $1,162 (24 units) from $64; Waterproof Spray more than doubled to $817 (30 units vs 11).
refunds: Refunds were $59.64 on 2 units (1.5% of orders), vs $8.70 on 1 unit the week before.
One Refresh Kit and one pack of Laundry Sheets; nothing points to a product problem.
pacing_reco: November is $13,467 through Nov 22, 75% ahead of the same days last year ($7,694), and pacing to about $18,364. BF/CM (Nov 27–30) decides whether it beats October's $20,121.
ads_context: ACoS rose to 41.3% from 33.5%, but TACoS fell to 15.6% from 17.2% because sales grew faster than spend.
Each $1 of ads returned $2.42 in ad sales, down from $2.98; ads drove 38% of revenue.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $1,010 on $265 (26.2% ACoS, 25 orders).
Category keywords took $440 for $875 (50.3% ACoS, 23 orders), up from $374 spent.
Competitor targets spent $93 for one $44 sale; Sponsored Brands spent $81 for $43.
bid_moves: Scale Signature Kit product defense ($30 → $388) and Essential Kit “sneaker cleaner” exact ($14 → $133).
Lower the “shoe cleaner” broad bid in the Solution campaign: $122 for $194 (62.8% ACoS).
Pause the 41 campaigns with spend and no sales ($227), led by Crep Protect competitor ($24).
coupons: This week: 0 coupon orders (0 last week). No coupon is running going into BF/CM.
promotions: This week: 16 promotion orders and $91 in promotional discounts (vs 14 orders and $68 last week).
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30 (this week).
Priority: restock Odor Eliminator (11 available, about 1 week left) before BF/CM.
